fields.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters, with letters and numbers. Avoid your name, your email and product names.

organization.lead: You will be its Owner. You can invite your team next.
organization.accept: I accept the <termsLink>{terms}</termsLink> and the <dpaLink>{dpa}</dpaLink> on behalf of this organization.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.body: You are invited to join {org} as {role}. The invitation expires {expires}.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to.

refused.invite_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid, or it was sent to a different email address. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
refused.invite_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then open the invitation link again.
refused.invite_inviter_inactive: The person who invited you can no longer add members. Ask an admin of the organization for a new invitation.
refused.seat_limit_reached: This organization has no seat left for your role. Ask its Owner to buy extra seats or upgrade the plan, then open the invitation again.
refused.seat_limit_upgrade: This organization has no seat left for your role. Ask its Owner to upgrade the plan, then open the invitation again.

session.expiredBody: Sign in again to keep working. Nothing on this page is lost.
session.signedOutElsewhere: You signed out in another tab.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match. Check both, or use a sign-in link instead.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you, then sign in.
errors.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password: Choose a different password: this one is too weak or appears in a known data breach. Use at least 12 characters with letters and numbers.
errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: We sent too many emails to this address. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.over_request_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.provider_disabled: That sign-in method is not turned on for Atlas yet. Use email instead.
errors.link_invalid: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.password: Enter a password of at least 12 characters with letters and numbers.
errors.passwordContext: Choose a password that does not contain your name, your email or a product name such as Atlas.
errors.orgSlug: Use 2 to 48 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
errors.accept: Accept the Terms of Service and the Data Processing Agreement to continue.
errors.slug_taken: That web address is already in use. Choose another.
errors.slug_reserved: That web address is reserved by Atlas. Choose another.

members.removeBody: {name} loses access to {org} at once. Their records stay.

errors.email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.role_band: You can give only roles at or below your own.

errors.grant_exceeds_holder: You can give only roles whose capabilities you hold yourself.

errors.plan_limit_exceeded: Your plan has no seat left for that role. Choose Viewer or Field, or compare plans.
errors.seat_limit_reached: All seats on your plan are in use. Buy extra seats in Billing and Plan, or upgrade the plan. Viewer and Field roles never take a seat.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
